subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 90-
guide_solution: Summary 127 107, Central Road Dhaka 3 October, 2015 My dear Bipu, I hope, you are well by the grace of Allah. I am very much pleased to receive the gift sent by you on my birthday. I expected your presence in the function. But, you have written that you failed to attend the function because of illness. However, you have remembered my birthday and proved it by sending a nice mobile set to me. It was a great pleasure for me. I believe that only giving thanks to you will not do. I offer my heartiest love to you. Convey my best regards to your parents and love to the younger ones. Yours ever, Rimu
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 79 — Comilla Modern High School
